name: Nova Media Cleaner
author: haroondev

sections.description:
Nova Media Cleaner is a professional-grade media library optimizer for WordPress. It helps you keep your site lean and fast by identifying duplicate images using advanced hash-based comparison, removing hidden bloat, and optimizing your media assets with one click.

Whether you’re running a small blog or a large e-commerce store, Nova Media Cleaner boosts your site performance, improves SEO, and lowers your server storage costs instantly.

Features

  • Duplicate Finder: Identify and remove twin images stretching your database storage.
  • Smart Comparison: Professional side-by-side view to compare duplicates before deletion.
  • Safe Cleanup: Automatic reference remapping ensures your posts and pages never have broken images.
  • Storage Analysis: See exactly which images are eating up your space with detailed file metadata.
  • WebP Conversion: Convert images to next-gen formats for up to 80% smaller file sizes.
  • Unassigned Media Finder: Scan and remove media files that are not attached or used in any posts, pages, or WooCommerce products.
  • Smart Optimization: High-fidelity image compression without losing visual quality.
  • Unlimited Scanning: Process your entire library efficiently.

External Services

This plugin’s Pro License Activation feature connects to the Lemon Squeezy licensing API to activate, validate, and deactivate a Nova Media Cleaner Pro license key. This connection is only made when you (or a site administrator) enter a license key on the Settings > License screen, or automatically once per day afterward to confirm the license is still valid.

Data sent: your license key and a site identifier (your domain name) are sent to Lemon Squeezy.

This service is used exclusively for the optional Pro upgrade and is not required to use the core (free) features of this plugin.

  • Service: Lemon Squeezy
  • Terms of Service: https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nova-media-cleaner directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Media -> Nova Media Cleaner to start your scan.
sections.faq:
Is it safe to delete duplicates?

Yes, Nova Media Cleaner identifies exact match duplicates and only removes redundant entries while keeping the original safe.

Does it affect image quality?

Standard cleanup doesn’t touch the image content. Image optimization uses smart compression to keep visuals crystal clear.
sections.changelog:
1.2.16

  • Permanent fix: the Duplicate Cleaner’s tab/filter/search AJAX endpoint and the counts recalculated after any delete/restore/ignore action had the same unbounded per-duplicate database queries the dashboard page itself had in 1.2.11 – now fixed the same way (bulk queries instead of one-by-one, cached usage status).
  • Permanent fix: on sites using a page builder (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Avada, Beaver Builder) with large per-page saved data, the “is this image in use” check could take several seconds per image because it was scanning the same large page-builder data twice. It’s now scanned once, and any single field larger than ~500KB is skipped rather than scanned in full, so this can no longer stall a page load.
  • Permanent fix: any duplicate whose “in use” status hasn’t been computed yet (from a scan run before 1.2.11) now gets it computed and permanently saved the moment it’s first checked, instead of being recalculated on every page view – so even on a slow site, this can only ever be slow once per duplicate, never twice.
  • Permanent fix: computing “in use” status for newly found duplicates during a scan (manual or scheduled Auto-Scan) is now time-budgeted like the rest of the scan, so a batch that happens to find several duplicates on a page-builder-heavy site can no longer make the scan itself time out.
  • Added a fatal-error log: if anything still goes wrong while rendering an admin page or handling a request, it’s now recorded in the plugin’s own Activity Log (NMC Settings > Logs & Debug) so an issue can be diagnosed without needing WP_DEBUG or server log access.
  • Fixed the Activity Log’s “View Log” button and log viewer, which were missing from the Logs & Debug screen entirely (the underlying feature existed but had no way to display it).

1.2.11

  • Permanent fix (follow-up to 1.2.10): the Duplicate Cleaner’s “in use” check for each duplicate is now computed once during the scan itself and cached with the results, instead of being recalculated from scratch on every dashboard page view. This removes the risk of a timeout entirely instead of just capping it, and also makes the dashboard noticeably faster to load on sites with many duplicates.
  • Permanent fix: the Unassigned Media deep-scan (which checks every candidate file against posts, pages, products, widgets, etc.) now runs as a background batched scan with a progress indicator instead of a single long-running request, so it can never hit a server or PHP timeout no matter how large the media library is.

1.2.10

  • Critical fix: the Duplicate Cleaner dashboard could time out (504 Gateway Timeout / blank white screen) on real sites with a meaningful number of duplicates or a large database, because it ran several expensive usage-lookup queries for every duplicate on every page load just to compute filter-tab counts. This is now capped so the page always loads.
  • Fixed the new Unassigned Media “unused files” teaser running a full, uncapped deep scan synchronously on every page load (also capable of timing out large libraries) – it now loads asynchronously via AJAX using a lightweight query, after the page itself has already rendered.
  • Hardened the Duplicate Cleaner dashboard against a fatal error if a helper function is ever unavailable (e.g. due to a stale PHP opcode cache after an update), so a Pro-badge display issue can never take down the whole page.

1.2.9

  • Fixed duplicate scan reliability: ties in the scan order no longer cause real duplicates to be silently skipped, and duplicate/unassigned usage checks now consistently ignore trashed posts.
  • Added optional Near-Duplicate (perceptual hash) detection alongside exact hash matching.
  • Added a first-run empty-state screen for the dashboard instead of a blank/confusing scan view.
  • Added an Ignore/Unignore option for duplicate items, matching the existing Unassigned Media workflow.
  • Added a “Recently Optimized” list with 1-click Restore and pagination to the Image Optimization tool.
  • Free tier deletes now use WordPress’s own native Trash (instead of permanent delete), so accidentally removed media stays recoverable for 30 days without needing any Pro upgrade.
  • Pro’s Staging Trash now supports an automatic retention/auto-purge policy with a configurable “Trash Retention (Days)” setting, so trashed items don’t accumulate forever.
  • Fixed the Trash tab showing an incorrect count/empty mismatch, and added a clear “Pro Feature” lock screen (instead of a generic “No items found”) when a Free user opens the Trash tab.
  • Fixed the Pro crown/badge icon incorrectly appearing on licensed Pro sites that had “Skip Trash” enabled.
  • Hardened license checks across Unassigned Media, Media Renamer, and Bulk Alt Text so these remain properly gated on an active Pro license rather than just the Pro plugin being installed.
  • Removed the sticky footer bar; “Official Website” and “Documentation” links now live in the header.
  • Simplified the Settings page by removing several non-functional legacy options, and wired up real behavior for Images Only, Skip Trash, Hide Thumbnails, and Warning Message.
  • Various WP-CLI command fixes to prevent fatal errors on optimize, restore-image, and generate-alt.
  • Fixed the Pro Filesystem Orphaned Scanner permanently deleting files with unlink() instead of routing through Staging Trash like every other module – orphaned files are now recoverable too.
  • Fixed the daily Pro license re-validation check (refund/cancellation detection) never actually running – it is now properly scheduled.
  • Added an optional Scheduled Auto-Scan (Settings > Advanced): runs a duplicate scan automatically on a daily or weekly schedule, with an optional email report.
  • Added a languages/nova-media-cleaner.pot translation template.
  • Added the missing “Filesystem Scan” admin page – the Pro Filesystem Orphaned Scanner had a working backend but no menu item or page to access it from.
  • Fixed several “No items found” empty states (Unassigned Media Trash tab, Bulk Alt Text, Recently Optimized list) that lost their table header or showed no message at all.
  • Fixed wp nova-cleaner license deactivate never releasing the activation slot on the license server, and license activate not storing the instance ID needed to release it later – both could leave a license “stuck” as used up on an old site.
  • Fixed wp nova-cleaner license status printing the full license key in plaintext for inactive/expired licenses.
  • Added logging and clearer messaging around license activation/deactivation so support can diagnose “Pro suddenly turned off” reports.
  • Removed a dead, unreachable legacy license activation/deactivation code path in the Settings page controller that used an outdated hash formula and none of the safeguards above.
  • Removed the unused “Deactivation Feedback” modal and its wipe-data trigger – it was disabled on plugins.php years ago (it once blocked deactivation for every plugin, not just this one) and had no working replacement, so it never actually appeared to users.
  • Fixed a leftover reference to the removed “buffer settings” in the Help & Support page’s documentation blurb.
  • Fixed Image Optimizer’s 1-Click Restore only reverting the full-size image after a WebP conversion, leaving every thumbnail size permanently converted with a broken backup lookup.
  • Fixed Image Optimizer marking a failed optimization (missing file) as done, permanently skipping that image from all future optimize batches.
  • Fixed automatic WebP conversion on upload never creating a backup, regardless of the “Enable Backups” setting – those images could never be restored.
  • Added a free-tier teaser on the Unassigned Media screen showing how many unused files and how much storage they’re wasting, so you know what you’d get before upgrading.
  • Cleaned up internal CSS class naming and code comments that referenced a competing product.
  • Disclosed the Lemon Squeezy license-server connection used by Pro License Activation in this readme, per the plugin directory’s external services requirement.

1.2.7

  • Bundled local Roboto font files inside plugin assets for 100% GDPR compliance, privacy, and faster loading.
  • Removed external Google Fonts API dependencies.
  • Updated admin UI typography to use local Roboto fonts.

1.2.6

  • Added usage detection for ACF & Custom Post Meta fields.
  • Added usage detection for popular Page Builders (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Avada, Beaver Builder).
  • Added Theme Settings, Site Logo, and Favicon usage detection.
  • Enhanced plugin deactivation cleanup handler.

1.2.5

  • Fixed plugin deactivation popup window freeze on plugins page.
  • Enhanced deactivate/disable action link detection and JS redirection fallback.
  • Improved database cleanup handler execution flow.

1.2.4

  • Fixed Start Advanced Scan event handler and lock clearing mechanism.
  • Added custom number input for Unassigned Media batch cleanup limit.
  • Full-screen wide Image Comparison modal with full admin dashboard backdrop blur.
  • Optimistic UI row deletion for instant media cleanup response.
  • Fixed plugin deactivation popup for managing database settings cleanup.

1.2.3

  • Added interactive deactivation popup modal.
  • Added option for users to cleanly remove database settings and temporary files upon deactivation.

1.2.2

  • Code refinement and stability improvements.

1.2.1

  • Fixed single card “Delete Copy” button JS handler to open confirmation modal instead of failing silently.
  • Added dynamic warning modal title and custom confirmation text for non-in-use duplicate deletions.
  • Replaced raw emoji status indicators (🟢 and 🟡) with modern CSS micro-status badges (Emerald & Amber pills).
  • Enhanced “Delete Copy” button contrast with high-visibility trash icon and smooth hover micro-animations.

1.2.0

  • Removed all limitations and made all features fully functional.
  • Performance & memory optimization during scans.
  • Progress bar UI improvements.

1.1.0

  • Added Comparison Modal.
  • Local ZIP backups.
  • Paginated results.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
